236-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
236-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
236-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5170-6798-8175.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

803-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
803-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

529-2079-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1251-1395-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

620-1429-2981.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-1974.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-1974.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-1974.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2590-4068-5776-7313.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2590-4068-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

4316-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1651-3340-4772-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

112-3258-6496.manaNeeded: {12}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-3258-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-3258-6496.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and exiling the original Beacon of Tomorrows with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Beacon of Tomorrows copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Beacon of Tomorrows and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Beacon of Tomorrows's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Beacon of Tomorrows and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Beacon of Tomorrows's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-3258-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Beacon of Tomorrows is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Beacon of Tomorrows is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1545-3490-4017-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4017-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1651-4426-5921-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-4426-5921-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-4426-5921-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2060-2325-2919-4222.description:
Activate Soulmender by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Soulmender.
Repeat.

222-527-2034-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
222-527-2034-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2908-3682-5542-6556.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-5789.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-5789.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1339-4094-5349.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four tokens.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1339-4094-5349.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat from step 2.

567-1981-2397-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1981-2397-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1965-2500-3375-4600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1965-2500-3375-4600.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Omarthis until end of turn.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

uses.n: Rona, Herald of Invasion // Rona, Tolarian Obliterator

1547-1792-3682.notablePrerequisites: Rona does not have summoning sickness.
1547-1792-3682.description:
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Rona.
Activate Rona by tapping it, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Rona triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and/or planeswalkers you control.
Repeat from step 3.

427-1636-2292-2527-4170.notablePrerequisites: Fain and Kydele do not have summoning sickness.
427-1636-2292-2527-4170.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Kydele triggers, giving creatures that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
Viscera Seer dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Viscera Seer enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from Viscera Seer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to get infinite Inklings, and thus infinite +1/+1 counters via Fain.

323-1263-2034-3479.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
323-1263-2034-3479.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}.
Life Insurance and Falkenrath Noble triggers.
Resolve the Life Insurance trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and creating a Treasure token Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Activate Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

916-1168-1651-1737.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Vault of Whispers.
The Vault of Whispers token enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock artifact equipment token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Vault of Whispers token and the Rock token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

38-392-3359-3705.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Squee dies, triggering Hofri, exiling Squee and creating a token copy of it that's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {R}.
The Squee token dies, returning Squee from exile to your graveyard.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

575-1794-3983.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional black card in hand.
575-1794-3983.description:
Cast Ruthless Ripper by paying {B}.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Ruthless Ripper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

938-1582-2034-3771-5115.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1582-2034-3771-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2} to put a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

2104-4270-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
2104-4270-4423.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

3903-4469.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell and allowing them to cast a spell exiled by it without paying its mana cost.
When an opponent casts a spell this way, Lavinia triggers, countering that spell.

813-4305-4377.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Scholar of the Ages.
813-4305-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat.
